notice: OFFICIAL VERIFIED PESTICIDE RECOMMENDATIONS STORE - SOURCED EXCLUSIVELY FROM ANGRAU, TNAU, ICAR, AND CIB&RC PACKAGE OF PRACTICES

recommendations.mode_of_action_group: IRAC Group 4A (Rotate with Spinosad IRAC 5 or Fipronil IRAC 2B to prevent resistance)
recommendations.safety_precautions: Wear protective face mask, rubber gloves, and rubber boots. Spray across wind direction in early morning (6-9 AM) or late evening. Keep at least 50m away from fish ponds and bee hives. Store out of reach of children in original locked container.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Neem Oil 10,000 PPM @ 2.5 ml/L OR 5% NSKE (Neem Seed Kernel Extract) with blue sticky traps (15 traps/acre)
recommendations.evidence_quote: For control of chilli thrips, spray Thiamethoxam 25% WG at the rate of 0.33 g per litre of water (50 g per acre in 150 litres of water).
recommendations.publisher: Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU) Crop Protection Guide

recommendations.safety_precautions: Wear cloth mask during preparation. Mix thoroughly with 1 ml/L khadi soap or liquid detergent emulsifier before adding to tank.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Erect 15-20 blue sticky traps per acre; spray Beauveria bassiana 1% WP @ 5 g/L during humid evening hours.
recommendations.evidence_quote: In organic chilli production, spray Neem Oil 10000 PPM at 2.5 ml per litre of water (500 ml per acre in 200 litres) along with blue sticky traps.
recommendations.publisher: National Institute of Plant Health Management (NIPHM)

recommendations.mode_of_action_group: IRAC Group 28 Ryanodine Receptor Modulator (Rotate with Cartap hydrochloride 50% SP)
recommendations.safety_precautions: Maintain 5 cm standing water in paddy field during spraying. Wear mask and long boots. Do not contaminate irrigation canals.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Release Trichogramma japonicum egg parasitoid cards @ 40,000 eggs/acre; install 8 pheromone traps per acre.
recommendations.evidence_quote: For effective management of paddy stem borer, apply Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC at 60 ml per acre (0.3 ml per litre in 200 litres of water).
recommendations.publisher: ICAR - Central Research Institute for Dryland Agriculture (CRIDA)

recommendations.target_pest: Paddy Leaf and Neck Blast (Magnaporthe oryzae)
recommendations.mode_of_action_group: FRAC 16.1 (Rotate with Isoprothiolane 40% EC to avoid resistance)
recommendations.safety_precautions: Spray at first appearance of spindle-shaped lesions. Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer top-dressing during disease outbreaks.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Foliar spray with Pseudomonas fluorescens 1% WP @ 5 g/litre of water; seed treatment with Trichoderma viride.
recommendations.evidence_quote: Spray Tricyclazole 75% WP at 0.6 g per litre (120 g per acre in 200 litres) at boot leaf stage to protect against neck blast.

recommendations.mode_of_action_group: IRAC Group 6 Chloride Channel Activator (Rotate with Chlorantraniliprole IRAC 28 or Flubendiamide)
recommendations.safety_precautions: Ensure thorough coverage of squares and flowers. Do not graze cattle in sprayed fields within 14 days.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Spray HaNPV (Helicoverpa Nuclear Polyhedrosis Virus) @ 250 LE/acre with 1% jaggery solution in late evenings.
recommendations.evidence_quote: For pink and American bollworm in cotton, spray Emamectin benzoate 5% SG @ 80 g per acre (0.5 g per litre in 160 litres water).
recommendations.publisher: Professor Jayashankar Telangana State Agricultural University (PJTSAU)

recommendations.mode_of_action_group: IRAC Group 28 (Rotate with Spinosad 45% SC IRAC Group 5)
recommendations.safety_precautions: Observe strict 3-day Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI). Do not harvest ripe fruits for market within 3 days of spray.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Intercrop with African Marigold (1 row marigold for every 16 rows tomato) as trap crop; spray 5% NSKE @ 50 g/L.
recommendations.evidence_quote: Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC at 60 ml per acre (0.3 ml per litre of water) to control tomato fruit borer.
recommendations.publisher: ICAR - Indian Institute of Horticultural Research (IIHR)

recommendations.mode_of_action_group: FRAC Group M03 Multi-site contact activity (Low resistance risk)
recommendations.safety_precautions: Spray underside of lower foliage where concentric ring lesions first develop. Wear eye protection and gloves.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Seedling dip and soil application with Trichoderma viride 1% WP @ 5 g/litre; spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L.
recommendations.evidence_quote: For management of tomato early blight, spray Mancozeb 75% WP at the rate of 2.5 g per litre (500 g per acre in 200 litres of water).
recommendations.publisher: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU) Agritech Portal

recommendations.mode_of_action_group: FRAC Group M03 (Combine or alternate with Hexaconazole 5% EC for systemic control)
recommendations.safety_precautions: Avoid grazing cattle on groundnut haulms after spray until the harvest interval expires.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Foliar spray with 5% fermented butter-milk (sour curd) or Trichoderma harzianum @ 5 g/L.
recommendations.evidence_quote: At first appearance of Tikka spots, spray Mancozeb 75% WP at 2.5 g per litre of water (500 g per acre in 200 L water).

recommendations.mode_of_action_group: IRAC Group 28 (Direct spray strictly into plant whorls where larvae hide)
recommendations.safety_precautions: Direct the spray nozzle into the central whorl of each maize plant. Use coarse droplet nozzle.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Apply whorl application of dry sand mixed with neem seed powder (9:1 ratio) or spray Metarhizium rileyi @ 5 g/L.
recommendations.evidence_quote: For whorl application against Fall Armyworm in maize, spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 60 ml per acre (0.3 ml/L in 200 litres water).

recommendations.mode_of_action_group: FRAC Group 3 DMI (Rotate with mineral oil or Mancozeb to prevent resistance)
recommendations.safety_precautions: Spray during clear weather on both upper and lower surface of leaves. Cut and destroy dried infected leaves.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Spray 1% mineral oil emulsion (banana spray oil) along with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L.
recommendations.evidence_quote: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC at the rate of 1.0 ml per litre (200 ml per acre in 200 L water) mixed with mineral oil at 10 ml/L.

recommendations.mode_of_action_group: FRAC Group 3 (Apply first spray when panicles emerge, second at fruit set)
recommendations.safety_precautions: Do not spray during full bloom mid-day to prevent harming honeybee pollinators.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Foliar spray with Wettable Sulphur 80% WDG @ 3.0 g/litre of water before panicle opening.
recommendations.evidence_quote: Spray Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 1.5 ml per litre of water (300 ml per acre in 200 litres water) to control powdery mildew in mango panicles.

recommendations.safety_precautions: Wear mask and gloves. Spray early morning.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Neem Oil 10,000 PPM @ 2.5 ml/L
recommendations.evidence_quote: For whitefly in chilli, spray Thiamethoxam 25% WG at the rate of 0.33 g per litre of water (50 g per acre in 150 L water).

recommendations.safety_precautions: Target underside of canopy where whiteflies feed.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Neem Seed Kernel Extract 5% NSKE @ 50 g/L
recommendations.evidence_quote: For management of cotton whitefly, spray Flonicamid 50% WG at 0.35 g per litre (60 g per acre in 180 litres water).

recommendations.safety_precautions: Ensure spray droplets penetrate folded leaf canopy.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Release Trichogramma cards @ 40,000/acre
recommendations.evidence_quote: Apply Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3 ml per litre of water (60 ml per acre in 200 L water) for rice leaf folder.

recommendations.safety_precautions: Spray during early morning. Do not spray during peak bee foraging hours.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Spray 5% NSKE or Neem Oil 10,000 PPM @ 2.5 ml/L
recommendations.evidence_quote: For control of aphids in tomato, spray Imidacloprid 17.8% SL at the rate of 0.3 ml per litre (50 ml per acre in 160 litres water).

recommendations.safety_precautions: Drench root zone thoroughly around plant bases.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Soil application of Metarhizium anisopliae @ 2 kg/acre mixed with FYM
recommendations.evidence_quote: For white grub management in groundnut, drench Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3 ml per litre of water (50 ml per acre in 160 L water).

recommendations.safety_precautions: Spray when hopper burn symptoms appear on outer leaves.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Spray 5% NSKE @ 50 g/L or Verticillium lecanii @ 5 g/L
recommendations.evidence_quote: For effective control of jassids in cotton, spray Flonicamid 50% WG at 0.35 g per litre of water (60 g per acre in 180 L water).
recommendations.publisher: Professor Jayashankar Telangana State Agricultural University (PJTSAU)

recommendations.safety_precautions: Mix with soap emulsifier before tank mixing. Spray underside of leaves.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Foliar spray with Wettable Sulphur 80% WDG @ 3 g/L in organic rotation.
recommendations.evidence_quote: Spray Neem Oil 10000 PPM at 2.5 ml per litre of water (500 ml per acre in 200 L) thoroughly on lower leaf surfaces for yellow mites in chilli.
recommendations.publisher: National Institute of Plant Health Management (NIPHM)

recommendations.safety_precautions: Direct spray to the base of tillers where hoppers congregate. Drain field before spraying.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Maintain alleyways (1 foot gap every 2 meters); avoid excessive urea top-dressing.
recommendations.evidence_quote: For brown plant hopper management in rice, spray Flonicamid 50% WG at 0.35 g per litre (60 g per acre in 180 L water) directed at the plant base.

recommendations.target_pest: Tomato Damping Off / Collar Rot (Pythium / Rhizoctonia)
recommendations.safety_precautions: Do not mix with chemical copper or triazole fungicides. Apply in moist soil.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 10 g/kg seed and nursery bed drenching.
recommendations.evidence_quote: Drench nursery beds and root zone with Trichoderma viride 1% WP at 5.0 g per litre of water (1000 g per acre in 200 litres) against damping off.

recommendations.safety_precautions: Apply in late evening hours when humidity is high. Mix with 1% mineral banana oil.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Sanitation: cut and de-leaf infected foliage below 3rd functional leaf.
recommendations.evidence_quote: In organic banana cultivation, spray Pseudomonas fluorescens 1% WP at the rate of 5.0 g per litre (1000 g per acre in 200 L water) for Sigatoka control.

recommendations.safety_precautions: Spray on trunk and emergence of flower panicles. Do not spray during full bloom.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Foliar spray with Beauveria bassiana 1% WP @ 5 g/L during vegetative flush.
recommendations.evidence_quote: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8% SL at 0.3 ml per litre of water (50 ml per acre in 160 L water) at the time of panicle emergence against mango hoppers.

recommendations.safety_precautions: Drench nursery soil beds and young seedling collars thoroughly.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Drench with Trichoderma viride 1% WP @ 5 g/L
recommendations.evidence_quote: For damping off prevention in chilli nurseries, drench with Copper Oxychloride 50% WP at 2.5 g per litre of water (500 g per acre in 200 L water).

recommendations.safety_precautions: Spray during early egg laying stages before caterpillars bore into bolls.
recommendations.organic_alternative: Release Trichogramma egg parasitoids @ 50,000/acre; spray HaNPV @ 250 LE/acre.
recommendations.evidence_quote: In organic cotton cultivation, spray Neem Oil 10000 PPM @ 2.5 ml per litre of water (500 ml per acre in 200 L water) to manage bollworm oviposition.
recommendations.publisher: National Institute of Plant Health Management (NIPHM)
